intermediate.title: KOM Sprint (2) Montagna Grande di Viggiano (154 km

story: Stage 5 of the Giro d'Italia was raced in terrible weather conditions. After many failed attacks, a 12-man breakaway formed early on. On the climb to Viggiano, Igor Arrieta attacked and was joined by Alfonso Eulálio. Despite both riders crashing and Arrieta missing a corner, he recovered to beat Eulálio in a dramatic sprint finish.
